en.title: DAA 3.10.2(3)(c) refers twice to 'DAA 2.8.10(1)', which does not exist
en.summary: DAA section 2.8 ends at 2.8.8; there is no 2.8.10. The sibling subrules (2) and (3) of the same rule refer to '3.10.2 (1)' (the DASP risk warnings); the DATF equivalent is 2.8.5(1). Meaning survives by context.
en.correction: Please read "DAA 3.10.2(1)" for "DAA 2.8.10(1)" and "DAA 2.8.10 (1)" in 3.10.2(3)(c) (an editorial correction under section 19(3)(a) of the AIFC Regulations on AIFC Acts).
